title: AFRIGUARD: Safety and Robust Refusal For African Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance gap in safety intent classification, harm categorization, and refusal behavior between 10 African languages and their direct English translations to measure linguistic disparities in safety guardrails.
Assessing the cultural understanding and contextual appropriateness of model responses to country-specific African safety scenarios using an LLM-as-a-judge evaluation.
